items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: So finally, I said okay, and I directed the show and she'd play and her husband was the drummer, and the Nicholas Brothers were in the show.

ctx.x: Now the Nicholas Brothers -- they came after them, but I was directing a band over in Philadelphia, see, and the man comes to me and says -- no, I was playing piano, I also played piano, and he asked me why didn't I direct the band and let this woman -- and he was talking about Mrs. Nicholas, she was playing piano and her husband was a drummer.
